programInfo.label: Requirements
programInfo.value: Pass an independently administered, Department of Education approved, Ability to Benefit Test; concurrent enrollment in adult education and eligible post-secondary programs.

programInfo.value: Work toward earning your High School Diploma Equivalency while enrolled in a healthcare career program.

whyStudy.title: Why Study the Eligible Career Pathways Program
whyStudy.description: Combine career training in healthcare with support to earn your High School Diploma Equivalency.

items.description: Work toward earning your High School Diploma Equivalency while training in a healthcare program.
Receive support and regular check-ins from staff.
Access the computer lab and online support for the High School Diploma Equivalency component.
